ios_google_not_configured: Google sign-in is not set up in this version. Please connect Gmail with an app password.
ios_focus_desc: Group the inbox by importance: needs reply, important, can wait, promotions & newsletters.
ios_notif_buttons_desc: Which actions appear directly in a new-mail notification (long press). At most 3 — change the order with the arrows.
ios_eco_desc: No real-time connection and no push server registration: iOS only checks in the background (roughly every 15–60 minutes). Notifications may be delayed accordingly.
ios_ai_none: None — no API key and no Apple Intelligence
ios_privacy_text: BlockMail connects directly to your mail server. Credentials and API keys are stored encrypted in the iOS keychain, mails and the search index stay on this device. Only what you set up yourself is shared: with your own Claude key, the mail texts being processed go to Anthropic; with your own push server, it receives the credentials needed to check mail. There are no ads and no tracking.
ios_setup_google_alt: Or without an app password: sign in directly with your Google account.
